statusHistory.note: Operator-commissioned (chat request) -> trust: auto per rules.md trust-gate. Primary editorial lead: Coifa's Aug 19, 2026 first-person interview with chef-owner Rodrigo Levino (a former Folha de S.Paulo/Playboy/VIP journalist who left the press around 2010-2013 as the industry contracted) about opening Jesuíno Brilhante in 2016 with his father João Batista as its face, sourcing directly from Caicó/Patu, Rio Grande do Norte, and the accessibility mandate behind it ('vou abrir um restaurante no período de crise, então ele precisa ser acessível'). Corroborated via CNN Brasil V&G (co-chef Kátia Mello, address, cuisine), Catraca Livre (sertão-potiguar framing), Viva a Cidade (verified real 10th-anniversary street party held May 31, 2026, plus ongoing 2026 anniversary programming -- guest-chef dinners and a house recipe book -- with no further specific forward date published as of this pass, so none nested as a dated child event per near-events' no-invented-dates rule), and Google Maps (4.7/1,786 reviews, R$60-80pp, LGBTQ+-welcoming designation, recent reviews read live for specifics: praise for carne de sol/baiao de dois, one dissenting review on underseasoning). Tripadvisor listing and CNN's 2023 anniversary piece confirm this is a decade-old, previously-covered neighborhood institution, not an undiscovered find -- but no multi-hour-queue or viral/TikTok-hype reports turned up in this pass, so it clears the anti-mainstream-hype bar; framed around Coifa's chef-interview angle rather than 'trending now'. dedupe-by-place (check-duplicates.mjs) run clean against lita-pinheiros-sao-paulo (same Pinheiros neighborhood, ~2.6km away, a wine bar -- different address, concept and cuisine) and the rest of the existing SP-capital food-drink catalogue. Reddit r/saopaulo and r/brasil searches (web-search backend, then site:reddit.com) returned no on-topic threads -- floor leg run, no result found, logged rather than skipped. Google reviews read live (leg met). Five-preferred-source floor met: coifa, catraca-livre, plus CNN Brasil, Viva a Cidade and Tripadvisor consulted for surrounding picture. Coordinates verified against the venue's own Google Maps listing pin (not geocoder-only) -- confidence 1.
